hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Given two distinct groups of intervals A and B, determine the number of pairs (a, b) that intersect.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: A and B intersect if max(a.start, b.start) is less than or equal to min(a.end, b.end).

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Deduce non-intersecting pairs where an interval in A finishes before B begins or vice versa.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

def countBipartiteIntersectingPairs(intervals_a: list[list[int]], intervals_b: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    n, m = len(intervals_a), len(intervals_b)
    total_pairs = n * m

    b_starts = sorted(iv[0] for iv in intervals_b)
    b_ends = sorted(iv[1] for iv in intervals_b)

    disjoint = 0
    for sa, ea in intervals_a:
        # B ends strictly before sa
        b_before_a = bisect.bisect_left(b_ends, sa)
        # B starts strictly after ea
        b_after_a = m - bisect.bisect_right(b_starts, ea)
        disjoint += b_before_a + b_after_a

    return total_pairs - disjoint
```

complexity.notes: Binary search over sorted endpoints counts disjoint cross-group pairs.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise nested iteration across groups takes O(n * m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted boundary arrays store n and m elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses complementary counting for bipartite interval intersections.

def countBipartiteIntersectingPairs(intervals_a: list[list[int]], intervals_b: list[list[int]]) -> int:
    n, m = len(intervals_a), len(intervals_b)
    total_pairs = n * m

    b_starts = sorted(iv[0] for iv in intervals_b)
    b_ends = sorted(iv[1] for iv in intervals_b)

    disjoint = 0
    for sa, ea in intervals_a:
        # B ends strictly before sa
        b_before_a = bisect.bisect_left(b_ends, sa)
        # B starts strictly after ea
        b_after_a = m - bisect.bisect_right(b_starts, ea)
        disjoint += b_before_a + b_after_a

    return total_pairs - disjoint
